# TC.SignalChange

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.SignalChange"></a>

### TC.SignalChange

This record gives one effective identity/count difference.
Signals that disappear use current=0.

### current

Current observed count, zero when now absent.

```text
TC.Int32
```

### previous

Prior admitted count, zero when previously absent.

```text
TC.Int32
```

### signal

Native identity with optional fields preserved.

```text
TC.SignalId
```
